scripts.test: bun test --preload ./src/setup.ts --path-ignore-patterns '**/e2e-native/**' src/ && bun test --preload ./src/e2e-native/setup-native.ts src/e2e-native/
scripts.test:coverage: bun test --coverage --preload ./src/setup.ts --path-ignore-patterns '**/e2e-native/**' src/ && bun test --coverage --preload ./src/e2e-native/setup-native.ts src/e2e-native/
scripts.test:watch: bun test --watch --preload ./src/setup.ts --path-ignore-patterns '**/e2e-native/**' src/ && bun test --watch --preload ./src/e2e-native/setup-native.ts src/e2e-native/
